steps.title: Calculate the reporting window
steps.change: The CTE reads order dates to produce one pair of bounds. The main query starts from individual orders because it needs one result per qualifying order. Subtract six days from the latest date to get seven inclusive calendar dates.
steps.added_sql:
WITH reporting_window AS (
    SELECT
        date(MAX(OrderDate)) AS latest_order_date,
        date(MAX(OrderDate), '-6 days') AS window_start
    FROM Orders
)
SELECT latest_order_date, window_start FROM reporting_window;

steps.title: Look up each order’s payment type
steps.change: Orders supplies the purchase rows and both lookup IDs. Orders 1 and 2 match UPI. LEFT JOIN also keeps order 3, whose payment ID is NULL.
steps.added_sql:
FROM Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN Payments AS p ON o.PaymentID = p.PaymentID
steps.sql:
SELECT o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, o.PaymentID, o.ShipperID,
       p.PaymentID AS matched_payment_id, p.PaymentType
FROM Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN Payments AS p ON o.PaymentID = p.PaymentID
ORDER BY o.OrderID;

steps.title: Look up the shipper for each order
steps.change: The working rows still carry Orders.ShipperID. Orders 1 and 2 match FastShip. Order 3 has no shipper ID and survives with NULL shipper fields. Both lookups use keys from Orders, so their positions can be exchanged.
steps.added_sql:
s.ShipperID AS matched_shipper_id, s.CompanyName
LEFT JOIN Shippers AS s ON o.ShipperID = s.ShipperID
steps.sql:
SELECT o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, o.PaymentID, o.ShipperID,
       p.PaymentID AS matched_payment_id, p.PaymentType,
       s.ShipperID AS matched_shipper_id, s.CompanyName
FROM Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN Payments AS p ON o.PaymentID = p.PaymentID
LEFT JOIN Shippers AS s ON o.ShipperID = s.ShipperID
ORDER BY o.OrderID;

steps.title: Keep orders within the window
steps.change: Each subquery returns one value and BETWEEN includes both endpoints. This query assumes ISO date-only text (YYYY-MM-DD), so the order date can be compared directly. With timestamps, use the earlier timestamp-safe version above.
steps.added_sql:
WITH reporting_window AS (
    SELECT
        date(MAX(OrderDate)) AS latest_order_date,
        date(MAX(OrderDate), '-6 days') AS window_start
    FROM Orders
)
-- …
WHERE (o.OrderDate) BETWEEN
    (SELECT window_start FROM reporting_window)
    AND
    (SELECT latest_order_date FROM reporting_window)
steps.sql:
WITH reporting_window AS (
    SELECT
        date(MAX(OrderDate)) AS latest_order_date,
        date(MAX(OrderDate), '-6 days') AS window_start
    FROM Orders
)
SELECT o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, p.PaymentType, s.CompanyName
FROM Orders AS o
LEFT JOIN Payments AS p ON o.PaymentID = p.PaymentID
LEFT JOIN Shippers AS s ON o.ShipperID = s.ShipperID
WHERE (o.OrderDate) BETWEEN
    (SELECT window_start FROM reporting_window)
    AND
    (SELECT latest_order_date FROM reporting_window)
ORDER BY o.OrderID;

steps.title: Label missing values and sort
steps.change: Unknown makes missing lookups visible, and the ID resolves ties on the order date.
steps.added_sql:
SELECT
    o.OrderID,
    o.OrderDate,
    COALESCE(p.PaymentType, 'Unknown') AS payment_type,
    COALESCE(s.CompanyName, 'Unknown') AS shipper_name
-- …
ORDER BY o.OrderDate DESC, o.OrderID DESC;
